scenes.text: Abhi bhi institute register aur Excel pe chala rahe ho?
Poore batch ki attendance ek tap mein, aur kaun absent hai, turant pata.
Pending fees track karo, aur har payment ki receipt print karo.
Har enquiry ki follow-up date, ek bhi admission haath se nahi jaayega.
Koi bhi subject, multiple chapters, answer key ke saath test, seconds mein.
